messages:
Mina: Quick follow-up from the KV shard postmortem — we need owners for remediation tests: regression promptset, focused load test, and a controlled chaos drill. Spike pattern aligns with nightly batch window.

Carla: I'll do the promptset. Will extract 5 seeds (cold, batch-spike, long-context, streaming, many-small). PR by Thu.

Sam: I'll build the k6 load script: ramp 100->2k rps in 10m and an optional TTL-override stage via admin API. Will include a kill-switch.

Josh: Attaching trace: https://redwood.internal/trace/EVT-2026-kv-evict and ticket TICKET-4821.

Mina: Acceptance: promptset fails CI on >10% p99 or >1.8x token cost vs baseline. Load pass = p95/p99 within baseline and token cost <2x.

Carla: Will tag prompts with "eviction_fingerprint" and include streaming/non-stream variants.

Sam: TTL override snippet to gate in load job:
`curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://ops-api.internal/shards/7/override-ttl -d '{"ttl_seconds":20}'`

ops-bot: Created TICKET-5300 "kv-evict test bundle" assigned Carla, Sam due 2026-05-14.

QA-bot: Nightly eval job added: evals/kv-evict runs 03:00 UTC -> #eng-platform on fail.

Mina: Tabletop Tue, live drill Wed next sprint. Carla=prompts Thu, Sam=load by Tue, Josh=monitoring by Mon. I'll write the post-drill summary. Ping here if blockers.
